chunks: You are worthy of beautiful description and abundant enumeration. If one looks forward to You with hope, You are the best of hoped-for goals; and if one places hope in You, You are the most honored of those hoped from.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say about God being worthy of description and hope in this supplication?
ai.summary: Found within the 'Al-Ashbaah' chapter of Nahj al-Balagha, this supplication highlights Imam Ali’s (AS) profound theological insight into the limitations of human language in capturing the Divine Essence. It underscores the Shia scholarly concept that while God transcends all descriptions, He remains the ultimate source of hope (marju) and expectation (ma'mul) for the believer.
